desc: Implement full solution: parse input; compute inverse permutations and distances to X along P and Q; check every initial ball is in its color's X-cycle; build red/blue required paths from the farthest ball to X, excluding X.
Compute LCS length of the two paths via position mapping and strict LIS; output len(R)+len(B)-LCS, with 0 when no required operations exist.
Run the provided samples and edge cases (no balls, balls only at X, unreachable cycles, conflicting orders) and fix any failures.
If the LIS implementation fails, re-evaluate using the equivalent 2D partial-order longest-chain/Fenwick method rather than polishing a broken greedy.
